Review Habits Garden?

Habits Garden earns strong praise for making habit-building feel fun and sticky. Users highlight its simple, uncluttered flow and playful quests that nudge daily consistency, with several reporting months of steady use and real wins—from quitting smoking to sustained streaks. The social leaderboard and “garden grows as you do” loop provide just enough dopamine to keep momentum, though one user found the productivity lift modest. A maker from EndurePath says it inspired their own build—underscoring thoughtful design choices and a gamification model that resonates across audiences.

Love the minimalistic landing page with the bare minimum text, I like that it is not overwhelming. It's simple, it's easy, it's Habit Garden! What really annoys me in a lot of habit trackers is that they make something very easy (habit tracking) utterly complex due to a lot of tabs and unnecessary functions. You chose a different road with Habit Garden which I like a lot. The built-in reference to Atomic Habits is gold - my personal habits bible. What comes next for Habit Garden?

I've used it on and off over the last 6 months, and each time I've given it a shot, it's helped me squeeze out enough extra dopamine to stick to whatever habit I was trying to lock in. Love your work Marc; keep it going, you legend 🙌
